title: Listing URL Filtering rules and URL categories without truncation

checks.do: Whether a URL Filtering rule list that stops at a round number, such as 100, is complete: compare it with `GET /urlFilteringRules/count` before reasoning about precedence.
Whether a URL category inventory read in one SDK call is complete: page it, or compare its count with the console.

vendor-count-then-loop.statement: Zscaler documents reading every URL Filtering rule by first getting the total from `GET /urlFilteringRules/count`, then requesting each page from 1 to the total divided by the page size, rounded up; its example uses a page size of 100, "or any desired size up to a max limit".

page-parameters-added.statement: The December 19, 2025 ZIA release note says `page` and `pageSize` query parameters are available for `GET /urlFilteringRules`, and that default values are used when they are not specified.

quotes: Two new query parameters, page and pageSize are available for the GET /urlFilteringRules endpoint.
When you do not specify the page and pageSize query parameters, the default values are used.

silent-truncation.statement: Treat a URL Filtering rule list whose length is a round page size, such as 100, as possibly truncated and confirm the total with `GET /urlFilteringRules/count`: if the endpoint returns fewer rules per page than the 1000 the Go SDK requests, `ReadAllPages` takes the first page for the last and stops without an error.
silent-truncation.conditions: Inferred from the SDK's stop condition; the endpoint's maximum page size is not documented.

categories-single-read.statement: The Go SDK's URL categories `GetAll` makes a single `Read` of `/urlCategories`; its comment says the API does not support pagination and returns all results in a single response.

quotes: urlCategoriesEndpoint = "/zia/api/v1/urlCategories"

categories-two-behaviors.statement: zscalerctl records two behaviors of `/urlCategories` on different tenants: one returned 20 records for a 5,000-record request (2026-07-29), and another returned the whole collection on every request whatever `page` and `pageSize` said (2026-10-14); what decides which a tenant does is not known, so its reader learns the response width and keeps paging.
categories-two-behaviors.conditions: zscalerctl's own live observations, recorded in its code; no Zscaler source states a page size for this endpoint.

quotes: GetAll issues a single Read, which is complete only on some tenants. One

incomplete-list-misleads-precedence.statement: Because evaluation stops at the first matching rule, a rule list that stops short can leave out rules that bear on which rule wins, so a precedence answer built from it can be wrong.
incomplete-list-misleads-precedence.conditions: Assumes the list is truncated; which rules are missing depends on the order the endpoint lists them in, which no source states.

page-size-limit.title: The maximum page size the URL Filtering rules endpoint honors
page-size-limit.blocks: stating the truncation mechanism as documented behavior
page-size-limit.detail: Zscaler's pagination article gives a page size of 100 "or any desired size up to a max limit" and states no limit; zscalerctl pages at 100 as the observed default boundary.
